name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Dragon Spark
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Dragon Spark pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Built on the Dragon Snacks strain, Dragon Spark brings a bold, layered profile: sweet tropical fruit up front with a zesty citrus snap, rounded out by a smooth, gassy-earthy finish. It's a punchy, flavor-forward smoke made for anyone who likes their sessions bright, sweet, and full of character.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Dragon Snacks strain — sweet tropical fruit with a gassy, earthy backbone
Bold Dragon Spark flavor — juicy tropical fruit with a zesty citrus edge
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Dragon Spark is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
